# Flagship Agent-mode example: spend control
# Demonstrates “law is CuNi” – exact multi-runtime decision
#
# Portable on every catalog seat (including the money-seat gate). The
# HTTP `link` form of the same law lives in examples/agent/spend_control.cuni
# and examples/link.cuni.

def can_spend(amount: int, cap: int) -> bool do
    ret amount <= cap
end
